meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会写小脚本操作浏览器:打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试网站;页面状态在多次脚本间保留。
howto.when: 当你提出任一浏览器交互请求时触发,例如打开网址、填表、截图等。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并返回标题和网址
say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回标题与 URL。

say.text: 登录这个网站,帮我填好表单并提交
say.note: 用扩展模式复用你已登录的 Chrome。

say.text: 截取当前页面的完整长图保存到 tmp/
say.note: 保存 fullPage 截图到 tmp/ 目录。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude writes small scripts that drive a browser: navigate sites, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, test web apps. Page state persists across script runs.
howto.when_en: Triggered by any browser interaction request, e.g. go to a URL, fill out a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, or test a website.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and tell me the page title and URL
say_en.note: Launches a browser and returns the title and URL.

say_en.text: Log into this site, fill out the form and submit it
say_en.note: Uses extension mode with your existing Chrome session.

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot and save it to tmp/
say_en.note: Saves a fullPage screenshot under tmp/.
